personality_one_liner: A vibrant, fast, and touchable grocery experience that blends dark-forward authority with hyper-approachable pastel quick-commerce energy.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, safe-area clearance at bottom, minimum 56pt tappable heights, use gap for grids.

do's: Sticky Location/Header bar over scrolling content

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: High-density, hyper-personalized Blinkit-style discovery hub with fast access to categories and repeat purchases.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for categories, centered spinner for personalized rows.
states.empty: Illustration of empty basket + 'Fresh items arriving soon' + Reload CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top Location Bar (glass or dark-forward brand surface) with Search Bar beneath it. Horizontal scroll view for 'Discover' chip filters using pastel red/yellow/green backgrounds. Hero promotional banners (horizontal snap carousel). 'Buy Again' horizontal product carousel. 2-col or 3-col Category Grid with pastel tiles. Followed by vertical feed of product grids. Safe area padding at bottom for tab bar.

screens.name: Store Profile
screens.purpose: Immersive showcase of a specific local store featuring rich media (videos/images) and their full catalog.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for media header and product list.
states.empty: Illustration of closed storefront + 'No products available right now' + Go Back CTA.

screens.layout: Top section: 2x2 grid (or horizontal scroll) containing 2 videos (mocked with play button overlay) and 2 images. Overlapping centered store logo (circular avatar, shadow 2, raised half over the media and half over content). Store metadata (name, delivery time, tags). Horizontal chip filters for store categories. 2-col grid of all store products below.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single grocery item focusing on high-quality imagery and quick add-to-cart action.

states.loading: Skeleton image block and text lines.
states.empty: Not applicable unless product removed, then 'Product unavailable' + Go Back.

screens.layout: Large product image at top (surfaceSecondary background). Title, weight/volume, price, and Blinkit-style delivery time indicator. Sticky primary 'Add to Cart' CTA at the bottom inside a glass container above the safe area.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review selected items, view total savings, and proceed to checkout quickly.

states.empty: Illustration of empty cart + 'Your cart is waiting for fresh items' + Browse CTA.

screens.layout: List of cart items with quantity steppers. Bill details summary card (surfaceSecondary). Sticky 'Checkout' CTA at the bottom with total amount displayed inside the button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality. Use oversized tap areas, soft radii (md/lg), and clear foreground/background layering.

Implement the 'Blinkit-style' Home screen: A dense but visually structured layout. The Discover chip filter bar must scroll horizontally and utilize the defined pastel traffic colors (pastelRed, pastelYellow, pastelGreen) for its chip backgrounds.

The Store Profile screen MUST have the specific header layout requested: a top section containing 2 videos (mocked via images with a play icon overlay) and 2 images, followed by an overlapping, centered circular store logo.

Integrate the One Latur dark-forward brand identity strategically. For instance, use the dark `brand` color (#1A1A1A) for the top Location/Header bar, creating strong contrast against the white search bar and light app body. This fulfills the 'dark-forward primary' request while keeping the shopping experience bright and tactile.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, quantity steppers) have minimum 44x44pt touch targets and trigger the mapped haptic feedback.
Apply `expo-glass-effect` (or `expo-blur`) on the bottom tab bar and sticky CTAs to maintain native mobile depth.
No auth screen is required. The app should launch directly into the Home tab.
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weight (either all filled or all outlined, except for tab active/inactive states).
